summary: Consent for clinical care is not automatically consent for biospecimen storage, future research use, genetic or genomic…
comment: Consent for clinical care is not automatically consent for biospecimen storage, future research use, genetic or genomic analysis, data sharing, cross-border transfer, re-contact or commercial collaboration. Participants need meaningful choices about storage and use of samples and associated data.

anchor.note: p.157 l.111–114 read as the printed page

public.text: Consent for clinical care is not automatically consent for biospecimen storage, future research use, genetic or genomic analysis, data sharing, cross-border transfer, re-contact or commercial collaboration. Participants need meaningful choices about storage and use of samples and associated data.
public.suggestedRevision: Require interoperable consent management that separately records consent for collection; storage; current-study use; future use; genetic/genomic analysis where relevant; sharing; cross-border transfer where relevant; re-contact; and withdrawal.
